First stage of an MCGLM, unit by unit (C++ kernel)

Source: R/RcppExports.R
cpp_first_stage_units.Rd

Forms, for every unit of a partition of the rows, the sum over its rows of the quasi-score and of the Pearson estimating functions of the first stage; the sensitivity of the first stage from its definition, the block of the covariance parameters on the regression parameters included; and the derivative of the Pearson residuals in the first-stage parameters.

Usage

cpp_first_stage_units(invC, C, Dblocks, DC, DCbeta, res, w, unit, n_units)

Arguments

invC

the \(nR \times nR\) inverse of the first-stage covariance.

C

the first-stage covariance.

Dblocks

list of \(R\) dense \(n \times p_r\) derivatives of the means in the regression parameters of each response.

DC

list of the derivatives of \(C\) in the covariance parameters.

DCbeta

list, one entry per regression parameter, of the derivatives of \(C\) in that parameter, or NULL where the variance does not depend on the mean.

res

raw residuals \(y - \mu\), stacked response by response.

w

prior weights of the first stage, one per stacked row.

unit

zero-based unit of each observational row, length \(n\).

n_units

number of units.

Value

A list with psi (n_units by \(p_1\)), the sensitivity S (\(p_1 \times p_1\), on the sign convention of mcglm, \(E(\partial\psi/\partial\alpha^\top)\)), G (\(nR\) by \(p_1\), the derivative of the Pearson residuals with the sign removed), r (the Pearson residuals), and the numbers n_beta of regression parameters and n_cov of covariance parameters, with \(p_1\) their sum.
